events.text: Human-acceptance build. Fortification markers are unlimited; printed capacities and enemy unit limits apply. Secure the Primary and Secondary Objectives on row 4 by turn 10. Achievement points also reward cleared positions, prisoners and casualty evacuation. This standalone mission uses simplified communications and event-driven ammunition; there are no vehicles or pyrotechnic signals.
